title: Create semantic token lattice for compact controls and dense data surfaces
creator: Aisha Ramos
description: Introduce a compact-first semantic token lattice that harmonizes color ramps, typographic scale, spacing/radius, and elevation for interactive tables, compact buttons, and chart overlays. Goal is to reduce visual noise in high-density surfaces while preserving contrast and motion affordances across themes and component states.
acceptance_criteria: A single semantic token set (compact mode) is defined and documented in Figma and tokens.json with names and usage guidance
Contrast ratios for text and interactive affordances meet WCAG AA for normal text and >=3:1 for iconography in compact mode
Spacing/radius primitives reduce per-component footprint by at least 12% versus current compact baseline without introducing overlap in table rows
Elevation/shadow steps for compact surfaces are rebalanced and validated against 3 representative components (table row, compact button, tooltip) in light and dark themes
Design tokens exported as a migration-ready delta file with clear rename maps and example migration snippets for the component library
notes: Trade-offs: tighter spacing improves information density but increases risk of touch-target regressions; we pair with small-touch mode for mobile where necessary
We prefer semantic names (surface-strong, interactive-muted) over numeric scale to encourage intent-driven usage across components
Will maintain a compatibility alias layer for legacy token names to reduce churn in engineering rollouts
Decided to limit new elevation steps to three for compact surfaces to simplify runtime shadow composition and GPU raster costs
comments: 2024-11-05 — Aisha Ramos: Created ticket and uploaded initial Figma explorations for compact token lattice. Called out three sample surfaces to validate: data table, compact primary/secondary button, micro-chart overlay.

2024-11-28 — Aisha Ramos: Updated acceptance criteria to require migration delta and alias map. Added WCAG contrast checks to the definition.

2024-12-03 — Liam Chen: Added notes about keeping only three elevation steps and preferring semantic naming. Draft PR created and awaiting design review in Figma. Engineering flagged one dependent API change: runtime-shadow-composition (ENG-1842).
2024-12-03 — QA: Planned test cases added to the migration checklist for desktop and mobile compact modes. Will run visual diff and contrast scans once PR is ready.
